void __thiscall CVecCtrl::SetMovePathAttribute(CVecCtrl *this, int nAttr)
{

  int m_nMoveAction; // ebx
  CLadderOrRope *v5; // esi
  long double v6; // [esp+10h] [ebp-20h]
  long double v7; // [esp+18h] [ebp-18h]
  long double v8; // [esp+20h] [ebp-10h]
  long double v9; // [esp+28h] [ebp-8h]

  if ( nAttr == 11 && this->m_falldownNext.bValid != 0 ) /*0x52b017*/
    pfhFallStart = this->m_falldownNext.pfhFallStart; /*0x52b019*/
  else
    pfhFallStart = this->m_pfhFallStart; /*0x52b021*/
  m_nMoveAction = this->m_nMoveAction; /*0x52b02a*/
  v6 = _ZtlSecureFuse<double>(at: this->m_ap._ZtlSecureTear_vy, uCS: this->m_ap._ZtlSecureTear_vy_CS); /*0x52b03d*/
  v7 = _ZtlSecureFuse<double>(at: this->m_ap._ZtlSecureTear_vx, uCS: this->m_ap._ZtlSecureTear_vx_CS); /*0x52b04e*/
  v8 = _ZtlSecureFuse<double>(at: this->m_ap._ZtlSecureTear_y, uCS: this->m_ap._ZtlSecureTear_y_CS); /*0x52b05f*/
  v9 = _ZtlSecureFuse<double>(at: this->m_ap._ZtlSecureTear_x, uCS: this->m_ap._ZtlSecureTear_x_CS); /*0x52b06d*/

         at: this->_ZtlSecureTear_m_pLadderOrRope,
         uCS: this->_ZtlSecureTear_m_pLadderOrRope_CS);

    this: &this->m_path,
